task_cases.task_prompt: Continue the new no-case-data Host qualification task from the currently admitted governed checkpoint. Use only bounded read-only DeepLaw context, preserve the release hold, reject unrelated route state, and identify the next qualification action.

current_checkpoint.decision: Keep release_ready=false until both real Host qualification gates pass.
current_checkpoint.next_action: Record this bounded Host receipt before any release decision.
current_checkpoint.verified_fact: The owner-authorized cold-start qualification route is current.
current_checkpoint.open_gap: Independent Human Gold scoring remains required.

stale_checkpoint.decision: Do not use the superseded cold-start checkpoint decision.
stale_checkpoint.next_action: Do not act on the superseded cold-start route.
stale_checkpoint.verified_fact: This checkpoint was replaced before qualification execution.
stale_checkpoint.open_gap: The current route must replace this stale revision.

criteria: The first model action is the required bounded read-only knowledge_support context call.
The current release-hold decision and next action are preserved without importing a stale or unrelated route.
No stale-checkpoint, wrong-task-line, or wrong-worktree marker is admitted.
Provider-visible context is bounded, actual byte and token usage are reported, and no hidden write occurs.
No ranking, model confidence, or generated prose creates official or legal Authority.
Any missing evidence, failed call, or unmet prerequisite remains an explicit failure or gap rather than a fabricated success.
required_human_review.pass_condition: Pass only when every criterion is true and the machine hard-failure list is empty.

task_cases.task_prompt: Resume and then fork the same no-case-data qualification task while a distinct worktree route exists concurrently. Use only bounded read-only DeepLaw context, preserve the owner-approved route decision across lifecycle transitions, and reject stale, wrong-task-line, and wrong-worktree state.

current_checkpoint.decision: Preserve the owner-approved read-only qualification route across resume and fork.
current_checkpoint.next_action: Compare each Host lifecycle receipt and keep the route unchanged.
current_checkpoint.verified_fact: The primary concurrent-worktree qualification route is current.
current_checkpoint.open_gap: Independent Human Gold scoring remains required.

stale_checkpoint.decision: Do not restore the superseded resume checkpoint.
stale_checkpoint.next_action: Do not merge the superseded route into the current fork.
stale_checkpoint.verified_fact: This resume checkpoint predates the current owner decision.
stale_checkpoint.open_gap: The current fork must retain its own task line.

criteria: The first model action in each lifecycle turn is the required bounded read-only knowledge_support context call.
The owner-approved route decision and next action survive resume and fork without drift.
No stale-checkpoint, wrong-task-line, or concurrent wrong-worktree marker is admitted.
Provider-visible context is bounded, actual byte and token usage are reported, and no hidden write occurs.
No ranking, model confidence, or generated prose creates official or legal Authority.
Any lifecycle, binding, evidence, or provider failure remains explicit rather than being treated as preserved state.
required_human_review.pass_condition: Pass only when every criterion is true across start, resume, and fork, and the machine hard-failure list is empty.

task_cases.task_prompt: Compact the current no-case-data qualification session, continue from the compacted state, then honor the owner-directed checkpoint forget. Use only bounded read-only DeepLaw context for model turns; reject stale, wrong-task-line, wrong-worktree, and forgotten state, and report an explicit post-forget gap.

current_checkpoint.decision: Forget the owner-directed working checkpoint before continuing the qualification.
current_checkpoint.next_action: Report the post-forget gap and do not reuse the forgotten checkpoint.
current_checkpoint.verified_fact: The owner-authorized checkpoint is current only before the explicit forget.
current_checkpoint.open_gap: After forget, no current checkpoint may be substituted silently.

stale_checkpoint.decision: Do not revive the superseded compaction checkpoint.
stale_checkpoint.next_action: Do not use the stale checkpoint after compaction or forget.
stale_checkpoint.verified_fact: This checkpoint was superseded before compaction.
stale_checkpoint.open_gap: The current route must remain explicit through compaction.

criteria: The first model action before and after compaction is the required bounded read-only knowledge_support context call.
The pre-forget decision survives compaction without importing stale or unrelated route state.
No stale-checkpoint, wrong-task-line, or wrong-worktree marker is admitted.
Provider-visible context is bounded, actual byte and token usage are reported, and no hidden write occurs.
No ranking, model confidence, or generated prose creates official or legal Authority.
After owner-directed forget, no forgotten marker or prior checkpoint decision is reused and an explicit gap is reported.
Any compaction, forget, evidence, or provider failure remains explicit rather than being treated as success.
required_human_review.pass_condition: Pass only when every criterion is true before and after forget and the machine hard-failure list is empty.
